title_en: Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is enacted pursuant to the Constitution for the purpose of safeguarding national sovereignty, security, and development interests, and protecting the lawful rights and interests of Chinese citizens and organizations.

Article 2 The People's Republic of China adheres to an independent foreign policy of peace, observes the five principles of mutual respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, mutual non-aggression, non-interference in each other's internal affairs, equality and mutual benefit, and peaceful coexistence, upholds the international system with the United Nations at its core and the international order based on international law, develops friendly cooperation with all countries in the world, and promotes the building of a community with a shared future for mankind.

Article 3 The People's Republic of China opposes hegemonism and power politics, and opposes any country interfering in China's internal affairs under any pretext or by any means.
Where a foreign country violates international law and the basic norms of international relations, and contains or suppresses China under various pretexts or pursuant to its domestic law, adopts discriminatory restrictive measures against Chinese citizens or organizations, or interferes in China's internal affairs, China shall have the right to take corresponding countermeasures.

Article 4 The relevant departments of the State Council may decide to include in a countermeasure list any individual or organization that directly or indirectly participates in the formulation, decision, or implementation of the discriminatory restrictive measures specified in Article 3 of this Law.
Article 7 The decisions made by the relevant departments of the State Council pursuant to Articles 4 to 6 of this Law shall be final.
Article 8 Where the circumstances on the basis of which countermeasures are taken change, the relevant departments of the State Council may suspend, modify, or revoke the countermeasures concerned.

Article 9 The determination, suspension, modification, or revocation of the countermeasure list and countermeasures shall be published by order of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or other relevant departments of the State Council.

Article 10 The State shall establish a coordination mechanism for countering foreign sanctions, responsible for overall coordination of relevant work.
The relevant departments of the State Council shall strengthen coordination and information sharing, and determine and implement the relevant countermeasures according to their respective functions and division of tasks.

Article 11 Organizations and individuals within China shall implement the countermeasures taken by the relevant departments of the State Council.
Any organization or individual that violates the preceding paragraph shall be dealt with according to law by the relevant departments of the State Council, which shall restrict or prohibit such organization or individual from engaging in relevant activities.

Article 12 No organization or individual may enforce or assist in enforcing the discriminatory restrictive measures adopted by a foreign country against Chinese citizens or organizations.
Where an organization or individual violates the preceding paragraph and infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of Chinese citizens or organizations, the Chinese citizens or organizations may initiate a prosecution with the People's Court according to law, demanding cessation of the infringement and compensation for losses.

Article 13 In addition to the provisions of this Law, relevant laws, administrative regulations, and departmental rules may provide for other necessary countermeasures against acts that endanger China's sovereignty, security, and development interests.
Article 14 Any organization or individual that fails to implement or cooperate in the implementation of countermeasures shall be subject to legal liability according to law.

Article 15 Where a foreign country, organization, or individual commits, assists, or supports acts that endanger China's sovereignty, security, or development interests, and necessary countermeasures need to be taken, the relevant provisions of this Law shall be applied mutatis mutandis.
Article 16 This Law shall come into force as of the date of its promulgation.
